answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network routes agent registration through a cryptographic prism, dispersing identities across a verifiable trellis of bounded trust graphs. Agents must validate each identity through a falcon signature over burned stake deposits. Economic friction scales superlinearly: registering k identities burns stake scaling as O(k^1.5), imposing exponential financial barriers that render multi-identity spamming mathematically ruinous for attackers.
